index_semantics.t: target slot index (final governed slot); a=anchor slot; d=displacement; all slot offsets are governed-bar counts, never wall-clock
index_semantics.invariant: every output is a pure function of bars at slots <= t; max_input_slot in each fixture is <= t
index_semantics.observed: value computed at origin t; display position t+d lies beyond the governed grid; the library emits no timestamp for it
index_semantics.displayed: value shown at slot t that was computed at origin t-d; uses bars <= t-d only
index_semantics.lagging_display: the lagging line observed at t is drawn at slot t-d; no output at slot t holds close[t+d], which cannot exist at t

context.parameter_envelope: R17 canonical context JSON chunked in 4096-codepoint Parameters context_000.. with context_schema, context_sha256, context_chunks, evidence_limit; operation parameters per producer; ConfigSpec identity ef2.<producer>, algorithm_version ef2-channels-v1
context.slots: at most 4096 governed slots, at most 64 sessions (R17 limits)
context.mode_rule: reset only in v1; carry deferred to a later amendment; any other context mode is INVALID_CONFIG (RF21)
context.window_rule: every window lies inside [anchor, target]; a window reaching before the anchor is insufficient_history, never shortened
context.pivot_exception: pivot_levels reads the whole immediately preceding governed session of the context, which may precede the anchor

status_precedence: missing_input/absent_input (no delivery, or an operand column absent from a supplied chunk that holds required slots)
reasons_unreachable: zero_denominator (all denominators are positive by construction)
counts: expected = closure slot count R (or the stated formula); observed = unique closure slots whose required fields, coverage and knowledge qualify
fixture_notation: compact, NOT canonical wire. bars: [session_index, high, low, close, volume, state] per governed slot; construction rule (verified against the shared BAR validator as in contract A): a positive-volume bar with any null OHLC column is refused (INVALID_SCHEMA), and zero volume requires ALL-null OHLC, which is the observed-empty slot (state empty, reasons observed_empty and no_eligible_observations); a null-field slot is therefore built with volume null and the listed OHLC value null; ordinary slots carry volume 100; integers are coefficients at scale; null = null field; state ok|gap (no row)|unknown (known_at null)|future (known_at > K)|empty (zero volume). columns lists the supplied BAR columns (h=high, l=low, c=close). anchor/target are global slot indices; target is the final slot. expected keys are full header ids; value null where not available; value_hex is float.hex of the float64; exact is the exact rational in currency units (or a 50-digit decimal for irrational values); max_input_slot is the latest slot in the closure. evidence: rows {row_id slot:<global index>, use consumed|excluded, reason (knowledge reason for excluded), boundary completed_interval} ordered by header id then slot and truncated result-wide at the fixture evidence_limit (default 1000, no truncation); only supplied rows that are consumed or knowledge-excluded appear (gaps, null-field and empty slots have no evidence row); a missing_input output has EMPTY evidence; evidence_total_closure_rows is the untruncated count.

numeric_policy.rule: Implementation follows the R17 policy (Decimal120 recurrences, one guarded final float64 conversion). The exact-fraction value and float.hex in each fixture are the REFERENCE r.
numeric_policy.tolerance: abs(y-r) <= max(8*ulp(r), 1e-12*abs(r)) against r = float(reference), docs/api/INTRADAY.md section Numeric error contract (R17)
numeric_policy.zero: where the reference is exactly 0 the result MUST be +0.0 (no relaxed rule). Each of the 8 zero-reference fixtures has exactly representable Decimal120 operands; the exactness argument per fixture is in zero_exactness. No documented deviation exists.

zero_exactness.KEL_04: flat bars: every true range is exactly 0, ATR seed and Wilder steps are exactly Decimal 0, so 2*m*0/E is exactly 0
zero_exactness.DON_05: HH and LL are equal integers, HH-LL is exactly 0
zero_exactness.PCT_05: Lt = 0 and Et = 0 are integer counts from exact cross-multiplication, (2*0+0)/(2c) is exactly 0
zero_exactness.PCT_10: Lt = 0 and Et = 0 from exact integer cross-multiplication of widths near 2^60, result exactly 0
zero_exactness.SQ_02_SQ_03_SQ_10: ema_period 1 and atr_period 1: EMA = close and ATR = true range are exact integers in Decimal120 (R17 recurrence with period 1 multiplies the previous value by 0); band_period 2: mu = (a+b)/2 and V = ((a-b)/2)^2 have power-of-two denominators, k^2*V is a terminating decimal, its Decimal sqrt is exact because the root is representable, multipliers 1, 1/2, 2 and 3 keep every product terminating, so the final Decimal subtraction is exactly 0 and normalizes to +0.0
zero_exactness.SQ_05: flat bars: EMA seed sum/3 = 1000 exactly and each step stays 1000, ATR = 0, V = 0, radius 0, so both gaps are exactly 0

numeric_policy.exact_cases: band_width_percentile ranking and bollinger_keltner_squeeze boolean: ranking compares exact integer/rational widths by integer cross-multiplication in arbitrary precision (never floats or Decimal); the bool uses exact algebra on the Decimal120 operands, so an exact boundary tie is a stable class only when the operands are exactly representable (SQ-02, SQ-03, SQ-05, SQ-10).

coordinator_decisions.state: decided by coordinator, pending owner review
coordinator_decisions.D1_to_D15: accepted as proposed; definitions in conventions

conventions.D1: Ichimoku extrema: high/low, midpoint (HH+LL)/2, window of P governed bars including the current bar. Alternatives: close-based extrema; window excluding the current bar.
conventions.D2: Ichimoku periods and displacement are explicit required config, no defaults; 9/26/52/26 only as a named fixture (ICH-14). Alternatives: built-in default; market-specific sets.
conventions.D3: Observation versus display: each leading span has an _observed (origin t, display t+d beyond grid, no timestamp) and a _displayed (shown at t, origin t-d) header; lagging line published only as lagging_line_observed (drawn at t-d) plus lagging_line_reference_close C[t-d].
conventions.D4: Every window, chain and displacement lies inside the anchored grid [anchor, target]; a window reaching before the anchor is insufficient_history, never shortened; older bars and old gaps never count.
conventions.D5: Leading span A is formed from exact extrema midpoints, never from the rounded published lines.
conventions.D6: Keltner: EMA(close) centre (R17 seed and recurrence), Wilder ATR, rational caller multiplier. Alternatives: SMA or typical-price centre, SMA-of-TR width.
conventions.D7: Keltner and squeeze consume the unrounded R17 Decimal120 EMA/ATR recurrence values, not published float64s.
conventions.D8: Donchian window of N bars including the current bar. Alternative: previous N bars.
conventions.D9: Classic floor pivots P, R1, S1, R2, S2 from the immediately preceding governed session's exact bar high/low/close, unclamped.
conventions.D10: Percentile: rank on exact squared Bollinger-style widths, target excluded, ties count half, fraction result (2L+E)/(2c).
conventions.D11: The ranked width is the R17 Bollinger-style width ratio 2k*sqrt(V)/mu with population variance and rational k; Keltner or Donchian width percentiles are non-goals.
conventions.D12: Squeeze: signed gaps (Keltner minus Bollinger upper; Bollinger minus Keltner lower) plus inclusive bool (gap >= 0 on both sides), no thresholds.
conventions.D13: Computed outputs are float64 (one conversion), the bool is bool.
conventions.D14: Six homogeneous producers with closed per-family parameter sets; a pivot context without a preceding session is missing_input/absent_input.
conventions.D15: R17 status/reason precedence, evidence rules and BAR admission are inherited unchanged.

coordinator_rulings.D10: exact squared-width ranking, target excluded, ties count half, fraction result: the v1 percentile convention of this contract; a shared rank convention may be adopted by EF3 later by amendment; no EQ-155 dependency in EF2 v1

coordinator_rulings.epoch_mode: reset only in v1 (aligned with contracts A and B): a context mode other than reset is a typed INVALID_CONFIG refusal (RF21); ICH-10 and PIV-07 (carry/mode fixtures) retired
coordinator_rulings.O4: pivots from the immediately preceding governed session exact BAR rows supplied by the caller via I/O mapping; not #506 period operands; no daily-grid context in v1
coordinator_rulings.O5: shifted values are published only for slots inside the supplied governed grid; nothing is extrapolated; a displayed value whose display or origin slot lies outside the grid is null/insufficient_history
coordinator_rulings.O6: retracement stays in the money-flow/retracement contract (PR #677)
coordinator_rulings.O7: evidence witnesses and limits reuse R17 values (evidence_limit 0..10000, sorted by feature id then slot, boundary completed_interval)
coordinator_rulings.O8: missing preceding session: missing_input / absent_input (R17 INTRADAY.md precedence table, first row)
